brief.analystNote: BTC at $82,221 is perched 0.5% below the Phase B→C boundary of $82,632 — a technically compelling position that is simultaneously undermined by deteriorating institutional flow data. The three most structurally bearish signals today are: LTH distribution at -9,085 BTC/day (the highest-conviction on-chain pressure), ETF outflows of -$244M versus a $264M/day inflow baseline, and stablecoin contraction of -$7.6B in seven days. These three together suggest that the capital required to sustain a Phase C breakout above $82,632 is not present today. The AMT framework reinforces caution: BALANCE with a coiling 7-day value area nested inside the 30-day range historically resolves in a sharp directional move, but spot is currently below both POCs ($84,386 and $85,116), placing the burden of proof on bulls. The sole institutional positive — CME basis at +6.64% HEALTHY CONTANGO — confirms some real-money carry interest, but carry trades do not by themselves drive spot higher. The mandate's Phase B add signal requires ETF flows above $500M/day and a confirmed daily close above $82,632; neither condition is met. The market regime note (insufficient history — 6 cycles vs 120+ needed for full anchor derivation) means phase anchors carry wider uncertainty bands than a mature-cycle system would produce — factor this into position sizing.
brief.riskWarning: A sustained daily close below 30d VAL $79,286 — combined with continued ETF outflows — would signal auction failure, invalidate the Phase B breakout thesis, and risk a retest of the 50d SMA at $80,710 or lower, forcing a defensive re-evaluation of the entire Phase B positioning.
